comments.body: Minor bug with “select all projects” cleared in a patch; story is done.

content.text: Minor bug with “select all projects” cleared in a patch; story is done.
The notification feed mixes every project and event type into one stream. People watching a single launch project cannot isolate signal from noise.

Add filter chips and a filter panel: multi-select projects the user belongs to, and event types (assignment, mention, status change, due soon, billing). Filters persist in local storage per user and apply to both inbox and the full feed page. Unread badge counts remain global unless “count only filtered” is toggled later—out of scope here.
Complete when deep links preserve filter query params, empty states explain active filters, and API GET /notifications accepts project_ids[] and types[] with a 100-item page size.
